name: agent-router
description: Choose subagent models with /agent-models and click the prompt panel to inspect activity, token usage, and routing. Requires Claude Code Mod function hooks enabled.

scout_model.title: Scout model
scout_model.description: Choose the scout's model with /agent-models, or enter an exact model ID.

scout_effort.title: Scout effort
scout_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the scout role. Default keeps the engine's effort; models without effort support ignore it.
